index.hero_subtitle: Syncloud runs your apps on a server you control
index.apps_title: What you can run on it
index.install_summary: We provide pre-installed hardware as well as disk images for you to convert your existing hardware into a personal cloud.
index.secure_summary: Syncloud device runs and stores all your data locally. In our commitment to transparency, we make our source code readily accessible to all users. This move reinforces our dedication to integrity and openness, underscoring our genuine desire to prioritize your privacy and security above all else. Syncloud device is available through the Internet at {link}.
index.secure_traffic: Do not worry, all Internet traffic is only between you and your Internet provider to guarantee privacy.
index.cost_summary: The software is free and open source, and the device, its apps and your data stay yours. The subscription pays for what runs around it: the address of your device, its HTTPS certificate, the relay that reaches it on networks that block direct access, the mail relay and support. The first month is free, then it is £7 a month. Use your domain name or ours at {link}.
index.opensource_summary: Syncloud would not be possible without the great open-source projects. We believe that open source technologies and products have more potential, better quality, stronger security, and simply they have more value. Therefore, Syncloud itself is an open source project. Fork us on GitHub!

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What does Syncloud do with my personal data?
faq.a1: Syncloud collects and stores a minimum of your personal information that is required to provide our services to you. We do not share your personal data with third parties. You can find our privacy policy on {link}.
faq.q2: Why do I need an account at syncloud.it?
faq.a2: Syncloud manages a domain name for each device and keeps it pointing at the device's address. An account at www.syncloud.it is what lets you control that name, and it is what the subscription is attached to.
faq.q11: What does the subscription pay for, and what happens without it?
faq.a11: The software is open source and the device is yours: it keeps running, with its apps and your data, whether or not you subscribe. The subscription pays for the services around it: the address of your device, automatic updates of that address when your IP changes, the HTTPS certificate, the relay, the mail relay and mail support. The first month is free. When a subscription ends the address is removed, so the device can no longer be opened by its name and the certificate stops renewing. Nothing on the device is deleted. Advanced users can manage their own domain and certificate, see {devmode}.
faq.q3: How can I access my Syncloud device?
faq.a3: Each Syncloud device has a domain name associated with it. You provide this domain name during device activation. For example, if you provided "mydomain" then your device should be accessible at the https://mydomain.syncloud.it address. You can always get the device address by logging into {link}.
faq.q4: What are the login and password to access my device?
faq.a4: You specify these credentials at device activation along with the device domain name. These credentials are not transferred anywhere, only you know them.
faq.q5: Can I access my device from anywhere through the Internet?
faq.a5: Yes, you can. By default, a Syncloud device is in internal mode. That means it is not available outside the home network. You can switch the Syncloud device to external mode. This will make it available from anywhere through the Internet as long as the Syncloud device is connected to the Internet. However, there are a few things to {know} before buying a device. You can find further information {here}.
faq.a6: Syncloud stores all data either on the device itself or on an attached external hard drive. This includes all data of Syncloud applications. It's not necessary to get an external hard disk to start using Syncloud. There are always a few free gigabytes on the SD card or flash memory, this space is used by Syncloud as storage.
faq.q7: Can I access my device with SSH?
faq.a7: Yes. The default account before activation is login: root, password: syncloud. After activation the password becomes the same as the device password.
faq.q8: Can I activate my device without a mobile application?
faq.a8: Yes. All you need to do is find out the device IP, usually on your router web page, and open https://<IP> in your browser. Then follow the activation procedure.
faq.q9: Where can I get more help?
faq.a10: Customers have 14 days after receiving the device to return it and get a refund. Postage costs are not refundable. Faulty devices are replaced for free within 6 months from the date of purchase.

download.write_desc: Write the downloaded image to the card or disk with {etcher}.
download.write_warning: Detach any other external drives first, so you do not erase the wrong one.
download.boot_desc: Power the device off, insert the card or disk, connect it to your router with the ethernet cable, then power it on.
download.vm_title: Download and create the virtual machine
download.vm_resize: The disk in the image is only 8 GB, so give it more room before the first start:
download.vm_create: Create a new virtual machine, type Linux, version Debian (64-bit), and do not attach an install disc.
download.vm_disk: For the hard disk, choose the existing virtual hard disk file you just extracted.
download.vm_network: In Settings, Network, set Adapter 1 to Bridged Adapter, so the machine gets its own address on your network.
download.vm_boot_desc: Start it and log in as root with the password syncloud, which stays invisible as you type. Run {command} to see the address to open in your browser.
download.docker_cgroup: Make sure Docker uses the systemd cgroup driver, or the container stops working after a restart:
download.docker_storage: Create a directory on an ext4 filesystem to keep the data in, for example /storage.
download.after_access: Turn on external access in Settings, Access, so the device and its apps are reachable from the internet.
download.help: Stuck on any step? Ask on {forum} and we will help.
